_meta.description: Additive overlay for filing through Digipoort (tax-digipoort-filing task 1.1). An XbrlInstance says what it files (`filingType`) and which VAT return it was built from (`sourceReturnId`); the entry point list gains the Belastingdienst OB (omzetbelasting) entry point, appended to the existing enum by the loader's list merge; a BtwAangifte points at the instance that files it (`xbrlInstanceId`); an XBRLTaxonomy record lists the entry points it carries (`entryPoints`), so the builders and the validation guard pick the taxonomy effective for a period and entry point. All new properties are optional, so existing rows keep validating.

filingType.description: What this instance files: a VAT return to the Belastingdienst (`vat-return`, entry point belastingdienst-ob) or the annual accounts to the KvK (`kvk-deponering`, entry point kvk-jaarrekening). Set by the builder that made the instance.
filingType.title: Filing type

sourceReturnId.description: The BtwAangifte this VAT return instance was built from. Empty for an annual accounts instance, which names its statement in sourceStatementId.
sourceReturnId.title: Source return

xbrlInstanceId.description: The XbrlInstance that files this return through Digipoort. The return mirrors that instance's state: submitted once the delivery is reported, accepted or rejected once the Belastingdienst's outcome is reported.
xbrlInstanceId.title: XBRL instance

entryPoints.description: The entry points this taxonomy version carries, such as belastingdienst-ob and kvk-jaarrekening. An instance is validated against the taxonomy effective for its period that lists its entry point.
entryPoints.title: Entry points

requiredConcepts.description: Per entry point, the concepts an instance must report before it may be validated, as prefix:name or bare name (any prefix), such as {"kvk-jaarrekening": ["jenv-bw2-i:Equity"]}. Read by the validation guard of XbrlInstance.
requiredConcepts.title: Required concepts

summations.description: Totals that must equal the sum of their parts in an instance of the named entry point, such as total assets as the sum of fixed and current assets. Read by the validation guard of XbrlInstance.
summations.title: Summations
